title_zh: 爆笑猫咪视频让她蚌埠住了
title_en: New Slang, New Stories (10/20): A Hilarious Cat Video Leaves Her "Bengbu"
note_en: Chinese internet slang loves 谐音梗 (xiéyīn gěng), puns based on similar sounds: 蚌埠 (Bèngbù), a real city, sounds like 绷不住 (bēng bu zhù) "can't hold it together." The 不住 in 绷不住 is a potential complement meaning "unable to keep (doing something)": 忍不住 "can't help it," 记不住 "can't remember." English needs "can't" plus a verb, while Chinese packs it all into verb + 不住.
